notes: Sourced from Bogen's official spec sheet PDF (doc 750-00023B, rev 02/2021), hosted on bogen.com. Chassis is half-rack-width x 1RU; optional 19" rack mount kit (NQ-RMK03) sold separately — rackUnits set to 1 (height). HDMI/DVI-D outputs have no stated version/bandwidth in the spec, so grade omitted. The 3.5mm Line Out/Mic In pair and the "dual NIC" note are both explicitly marked "reserved for future use" by Bogen on the spec sheet, though physically present. USB connector style (USB-A) and quantity (4x USB 3.0) confirmed by spec table; exact USB-A vs other form factor inferred from the product photo rather than stated in text. Second serial port is a single combo jack selectable among RS232/RS422/RS485.
